title: Will Donald Trump make between 220 and 239 Truth Social posts the week of Oct 25, 2026? 220-239
rules: If the number of Truth Social posts by Donald Trump from Oct 25, 2026 to Oct 31, 2026 is between 220 and 239, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The observation period begins at 12:00:00 AM ET on Oct 25, 2026 and ends at 11:59:59 PM ET on Oct 31, 2026.
The primary resolution source for this market is Roll Call.
In the event that Roll Call data is unavailable or inaccurate, alternative sources may be used at Kalshi's discretion.

Payout criteria

Truths, ReTruths, and Quote Truths are included in the total count.
Replies are included if captured by Roll Call.
"Between" is inclusive of the lower and upper bound.

Doesn’t count for payout: Posts deleted as of 12:00 AM ET.

blind.reasoning: Trump's 2026 baseline is about 19 posts/day (~133/week), and his record month of May averaged 27/day (~189/week). The 220-239 range needs ~31-34/day for the whole week. The final pre-midterm week and his habit of 100+ post late-night binges give real upside, but this narrow range is still above the most likely outcome.
blind.falsifier: Roll Call's count for Oct 25-31 shows a late-night binge or a midterm-eve surge that pushes the weekly total to 220-239.

final.reasoning: I moved partway toward the 13% midpoint because traders can see the live mid-week count and I couldn't. The remaining gap is too small to bet NO against people with better information on the week so far.
